posts.title: Building a Sci-Fi Terminal UI for the Web
posts.summary: How we ported the eDEX-UI desktop aesthetic — augmented borders, theme system, animated panels — into a fully static web blog running in any modern browser.

posts.title: Web Serial API: Talking to Hardware from the Browser
posts.summary: The Web Serial API lets Chrome connect directly to serial ports — UARTs, Arduinos, RS-232 devices — without any native app. Here's how it works and how we integrated it into the terminal window.

posts.title: CSS Variables & Dynamic Theming Done Right
posts.summary: eDEX-UI ships 20+ themes defined as JSON files. We inject them into :root CSS variables at runtime — no Sass, no build step required. Here's the pattern.

posts.title: xterm.js: A Full Terminal Emulator in the Browser
posts.summary: xterm.js powers VS Code's integrated terminal and eDEX-UI's shell. We look at how to embed it in a web page, handle keyboard input, implement command history, and pipe it to a Web Serial device.

posts.title: Draggable Windows with Vanilla JS — No Framework Needed
posts.summary: Creating smooth, draggable floating windows with mouse and touch support using only vanilla JS. Port of the eDEX-UI modal system to a browser context.
